actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own Eloqua action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your Eloqua connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: create_object
actions.title: Create record
actions.help: Create any standard or custom record in Eloqua. Select the object to create, then provide the data for creating the record.

input.name: object
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select an object. For example, account . A maximum of 1000 custom objects are returned. To retrieve other custom objects, toggle to Use object ID .

actions.name: delete_object
actions.title: Delete record
actions.help: Delete any standard or custom record. For example, contact via its record ID .

input.name: object
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select an object. For example, account . A maximum of 1000 custom objects are returned. To retrieve other custom objects, toggle to Use object ID .

actions.name: get_object_by_id
actions.title: Get record details
actions.help: Retrieve the details of any standard or custom record. For example, account , via its Eloqua ID.

input.name: object
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select an object. For example, account . A maximum of 1000 custom objects are returned. To retrieve other custom objects, toggle to Use object ID .

actions.name: search_object
actions.title: Search records
actions.help: The Search records action returns results that match all your search criteria. Use the depth parameter when making the request to specify the record information returned in the response.

input.name: object
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select an object. For example, account . A maximum of 1000 custom objects are returned. To retrieve other custom objects, toggle to Use object ID .

actions.name: update_object
actions.title: Update record
actions.help: Update any standard or custom record in Eloqua. For example, contact , via its ID.

input.name: object
